high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a gym or training facility. The individual is wearing a white sports bra and blue boxing shorts with white trim and some text on them. They have their hair tied back in a braid and are holding a smartphone with a black case featuring a cat design. The background includes a boxing ring with the word "OKA" prominently displayed on the top of the ring's canvas. The ring has black and white padding, and there is a wooden pallet or piece of wood leaning against the side of the ring.
